mostWorthwhile.text: Making collagen at the repair cell and following it into supporting fibers connected protein production to tissue repair in a concrete way.

leastWorthwhile.text: Closing the surface was a fairly predictable combination, though the resulting comparison showed why deeper repair was still needed.

surprise.text: The surface could close while the tissue beneath it remained weak; the equal-pull comparison made that distinction clear.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The item descriptions gave a practical reason for each combination.

continue.text: I would continue if another chapter explored a similarly concrete connection between cell activity and a visible body function. The repair sequence held my interest because each construction changed what the tissue could do.
